## 2. Inspected Source and Test Seams Ledger (Goal 2)

### 2.1 Status and Error Wire Envelopes
- `pkg/status/status.go`: `State` enum (`started`, `succeeded`, `failed`, `skipped` at lines 25-33), `ErrorInfo` (line 45), `Phase` (line 54), and `Event` (lines 89-100) with `OperationID` (`op-%d` from `operationSequence` at line 154 in `Run` at line 164) and `ParentOperationID`, with no `sequence` or `payload` field.
- `pkg/devcontainer/config/envelope.go`: `ResultEnvelope` (line 23), `ErrorEnvelope` (line 34), `StatusEnvelope` (lines 45-57, `SchemaVersion: 1`), `WriteCLIErrorJSON` (line 87), `ParseStatusLine` (line 109), `currentStatusFields` (lines 145-156), and `WriteStatusJSON` (line 181) enforce a closed field set (`SchemaVersion == 1`); CLI errors emit on `os.Stderr` via `cmd/root.go`.
- `desktop/src/shared/cli-error.ts`: `CliStatusEnvelope` (line 18), `isCurrentStatusEnvelope` (line 165), and `hasOnlyCurrentStatusFields` (line 202) enforce the same closed key set in TypeScript.
- Existing tests: `pkg/status/status_test.go`, `pkg/status/reporter_test.go`, `pkg/devcontainer/config/envelope_test.go`.

### 2.2 Provider Option Precedence, `UserProvided`, and Empty Semantics
- `pkg/config/config.go`: `CurrentSchemaVersion = 1` (`pkg/config/config.go:20`), `OptionValue{Value, Password, UserProvided, Filled, Children}` (`pkg/config/config.go:103-114`).
- `cmd/provider/configure_shared.go`: `ConfigureProvider` (`configure_shared.go:49`) -> `configureProviderOptions` (line 70) runs `InheritOptionsFromEnvironment` (`DEVSY_PROVIDER_<PROVIDER>_<OPTION>`), `parseAndMergeOptions` (line 181, preserving prior dynamic options via `mergeExistingOptions` at line 59 only when `!cfg.DiscardPriorValues && v.UserProvided`), then `ResolveOptions` and `runProviderInit` (line 127).
- `pkg/options/resolver/resolve.go` & `pkg/options/resolver/resolver.go`: `(*Resolver).computeOptionValue` (`resolve.go:183`) records `OptionValue{Value: userValue, UserProvided: true}` even when `userValue == ""`; `ResolveDefaultValue` (`resolver.go:18`) and `ResolveDefaultValues` (`resolver.go:30`) omit empty strings (`if resolvedValue == "" { continue }`), preserving native `DOCKER_HOST` and `DOCKER_CONTEXT` resolution in `providers/docker/provider.yaml` and `providers/podman/provider.yaml`.

### 2.3 Global Config Lock, Provider Operation/Init Locks, and Planned Durable Liveness
- `pkg/config/config.go`: `UpdateConfig` (`config.go:364`), `LockConfig` (`config.go:383`), and `LockConfigForContextDeletion` (`config.go:389`): blocking `flock` on `<configPath>.lock` with context-deletion intent check (`pkg/config/context_deletion.go`).
- `pkg/provider/operationlock.go`: `GetProviderOperationLock` (`operationlock.go:15`), `LockProvider` (`operationlock.go:29`), and `LockProviderNamed` (`operationlock.go:35`): blocking `flock` on `ContextsDir/<context>/locks/<provider>.provider-operation.lock`, used by `cmd/provider/{add,init,set,set_source,delete,rename,use}.go`.
- `pkg/provider/initlock.go`: `GetProviderInitLock` (`initlock.go:25`) and `ResolveInitState` (`initlock.go:40`): `flock` on `ContextsDir/<context>/locks/<provider>.provider-init.lock`, acquired with nonblocking `TryLock()` in `cmd/provider/configure_shared.go:248` (`initProvider`) and `TryRLock()` in `ResolveInitState` (`initlock.go:50`).
- **Required lock order and liveness model (`REVIEW_ADDENDUM.md` Section 2, planned `T00b`/`T07` seams)**:
  - Blocking lock order: `G (DependencyLocksDir()/references.lock, blocking with context timeout) -> LockConfig (<configPath>.lock) -> short registry/sidecar/config metadata commit`.
  - Permitted under `G` and `LockConfig`: only the bounded local metadata read/write/atomic-rename I/O required for the short registry/sidecar/config commit.
  - Forbidden under `G` or `LockConfig`: network I/O, interactive prompts, subprocess/probe/runtime execution, daemon/VM startup, or long-running workspace work. Artifact lock (`DependencyLocksDir()/artifacts/<artifact-id>.lock`) must be released before acquiring `G`.
  - `initLock` (`GetProviderInitLock`) is outside the blocking lock order: selection/removal must `TryLock()` the init lock and return `dependency_in_use` when init is active; code holding `initLock` must never acquire `G`.
  - Durable operation and launch lease liveness (planned `T00b`/`T07` seams, modeled on `pkg/task/store.go` `tryLock`/`claimDeadWorkerLock`):
    - Every dependency operation holds `DependencyLocksDir()/operations/<operation-id>.lock` from journal creation (`StateDir()/dependencies/operations/<operation-id>.json`) through terminal state.
    - Every launch lease holds `DependencyLocksDir()/leases/<lease-id>.lock` for the owned process lifetime alongside `StateDir()/dependencies/leases/<lease-id>.json` metadata.
    - Reconciliation treats a nonterminal operation journal or lease as dead only when nonblocking `flock.TryLock()` succeeds; while the lock is held, the operation or lease remains an active reference (`dependency_in_use`). PIDs recorded in metadata are diagnostic only.

### 2.4 Provider Binary Downloader and External Runtime Host
- `pkg/provider/download.go`: `verifyOrRemoveBinary` (`download.go:322`) removes the file at `binaryPath` on SHA-256 mismatch (line 331). External paths must never enter `DownloadBinaries` or `verifyOrRemoveBinary`.
- `pkg/provider/external.go`: `ResolveExternalRuntimeBinary` (`external.go:82`) verifies regular file, executable mode, and optional SHA-256 (`verifyExternalExecutable` at line 123) without downloading or deleting mismatched files.
- `pkg/driver/external/host.go`: `New` (`host.go:40`) resolves `binariesDir` via `agent.GetAgentBinariesDirFromWorkspaceDir(workspace.Origin)` and starts `devsy internal runtime-supervisor` with `provider.ToEnvironment(...)`.
- `pkg/driver/docker/docker.go`: `NewDockerDriver` (`docker.go:39`) calls `dockerHelper.EnsureElevated()` in the constructor (line 82), and `(*dockerDriver).Preflight` (`docker.go:116`, via `runPreflight` at line 193) calls `recoverPodman` (`docker.go:210, 303` -> `startPodmanMachine` at line 342 / `startPodmanSocket` at line 355) unless `DisableAutoStart` is set. Passive checks must never call `NewDockerDriver` or `Preflight`.

### 2.5 Desktop Wizard, Provider Job Ownership, and Privileged IPC Sender Policy
- `desktop/src/main/ipc.ts` & `desktop/src/main/provider-jobs.ts`: `provider_add` (`ipc.ts:1165`) runs `devsy provider add <src> --use=false` and starts `providerJobs.start(args.name, "installing")` (line 1183), which stays owned until `provider_init_streaming` (line 1244) or `provider_release_job` (line 1213); `provider_set_options` (`ipc.ts:1463`) runs `devsy provider set <name> --skip-init`.
- `desktop/src/renderer/src/lib/components/provider/ProviderWizard.svelte`: skips Configure when `visibleOptions.length === 0` (lines 366-369 in `handleSelect`, lines 408-413 in `handleConfigure`) and releases jobs via `releaseProviderJob` (defined at line 163, invoked at lines 229, 296, 345, 462, 489).
- `desktop/src/main/secret-ipc-policy.ts`: `isTrustedSecretIpcSender` (`secret-ipc-policy.ts:15`) validates `!win.isDestroyed()`, `event.sender === win.webContents`, `event.senderFrame === win.webContents.mainFrame`, and normalized `protocol//host/pathname`.

### 2.6 Release Workflow
- `.goreleaser.yml`, `desktop/electron-builder.yml`, and `.github/workflows/release.yml` build CLI binaries (`CGO_ENABLED=0`), stage `desktop/resources/bin` via `go run ./hack/release_artifacts stage`, and verify embedded macOS CLI architecture via `go run ./hack/release_artifacts verify`.

## 3. Contract Schema, Support Tuple Matrix, and Honest Acceptance Coverage Map (Goals 3 and 4)

### 3.1 Contract Fixtures and Frozen Reason Vocabulary in `pkg/dependencies/testdata/contracts/`
- `schema.json`: JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) for `devsy.dependencies.report.v1`.
  - **Frozen canonical `reasonCode` vocabulary (20 codes)**:
    - Documented success reason (1): `dependency_ready`.
    - `SPEC.md` Section 6.3 error reasons (16): `dependency_missing`, `dependency_incomplete`, `dependency_path_invalid`, `dependency_version_incompatible`, `dependency_version_unknown`, `dependency_platform_unsupported`, `dependency_policy_blocked`, `dependency_runtime_unreachable`, `dependency_auth_required`, `dependency_probe_timeout`, `dependency_integrity_failed`, `dependency_store_unwritable`, `dependency_recipe_unqualified`, `dependency_selection_stale`, `dependency_in_use`, `dependency_operation_interrupted`.
    - `REVIEW_ADDENDUM.md` Section 6 error reasons (3): `dependency_configuration_conflict`, `dependency_offline_asset_missing`, `dependency_indirect_launcher`.
    - Scenario-to-canonical mapping (no non-canonical aliases): partial pairs use `dependency_incomplete`; unsupported hosts use `dependency_platform_unsupported`; digest/archive/receipt integrity failures use `dependency_integrity_failed`; active lock/lease/reference refusals use `dependency_in_use`; canceled/interrupted operations use `dependency_operation_interrupted`; unowned removal refusals, custom source installer-trust blocks, and unavailable host/virtualization eligibility use `dependency_policy_blocked` alongside the orthogonal `availability`, `compatibility`, `reachability`, and `policy` dimensions.
  - **Test-owned candidate file observation (`$defs/candidateFileObservation`)**:
    - Available candidates record `observation.fileIdentity` (synthetic opaque file identity distinct from `lexicalPath`, `resolvedPath`, and `target.configRevision`/`target.providerConfigRevision`), optional `observation.platform` (`<goos>/<goarch>`), and optional `observation.observedVersion` (permitted only when `executed: true` in `active_probe`). Missing candidates omit `observation`.
- `report_missing.json`: Illustrative passive survey of missing external Docker CLI (`availability: "missing"`, `compatibility: "unknown"`, `reachability: "not_checked"`, `policy: "external_only"`, `reasonCode: "dependency_missing"`, `executed: false`, no fabricated `observation`).
- `report_external.json`: Illustrative active probe of external Homebrew Docker symlink with reachable daemon (`availability: "available"`, `compatibility: "compatible"`, `reachability: "reachable"`, `policy: "external_only"`, `reasonCode: "dependency_ready"`, `executed: true`, `isSymlink: true`, `observation.fileIdentity` + `platform` + `observedVersion`).
- `report_incomplete_pair.json`: Illustrative passive survey of incomplete MicroSandbox pair (`~/.local/bin/msb` with `observation.fileIdentity` and no `observedVersion`, missing `libkrunfw.so.5` with no `observation`, rejected `mise` shim with `dependency_indirect_launcher`, report/item/disabled `select` action using canonical `dependency_incomplete`).
- `report_managed_disabled_candidate.json`: Illustrative disabled prospective recipe on `linux/amd64` against `v0.1.11` (`policy: "managed_allowed"`, `reasonCode: "dependency_recipe_unqualified"`, `managedRecipe.enabled: false`, `qualificationState: "not_run"`, `blockingGates: ["G01", "G02", "G04", "G06", "G07", "G09"]`, `archiveLayout: "flat_verbatim_no_links"`, `expectedFiles: ["msb", "libkrunfw.so.5.6.1"]`, `install` action `enabled: false`).
- `report_unsupported_host.json`: Illustrative passive survey on `windows/amd64` (`virtualizationCapability: "unsupported"`, `policy: "unsupported"`, `reasonCode: "dependency_platform_unsupported"`, `reachability: "not_applicable"`, no `managedRecipe`).
- `report_stopped_runtime.json`: Illustrative active probe for `devsy-provider-orbstack` adapter `v1.1.4` with installed and compatible OrbStack CLI `v1.10.2` (`target.adapterVersion: "v1.1.4"`, `observation.observedVersion: "1.10.2"`) when daemon is stopped (`availability: "available"`, `compatibility: "compatible"`, `reachability: "unreachable"`, `reasonCode: "dependency_runtime_unreachable"`, `executed: true`, `observation.fileIdentity` + `platform` + `observedVersion`).
- `report_stale_target.json`: Illustrative passive snapshot with `providerConfigRevision: "prov-rev-msb-07"` superseded by `"prov-rev-msb-08"` (`compatibility: "unknown"`, `reasonCode: "dependency_selection_stale"`, `select` action `enabled: false`, available candidates carrying `observation.fileIdentity` and `platform` without passive `observedVersion`).

- `report_configuration_conflict.json`: Illustrative passive survey where `DEVSY_PROVIDER_DOCKER_DOCKER_PATH=/custom/missing/docker` (missing, no `observation`) conflicts with persisted `DOCKER_PATH=/usr/bin/docker` (available with `observation.fileIdentity`, `compatibility: "unknown"`, `reasonCode: "dependency_configuration_conflict"`, neither selected).
- `report_offline_asset_missing.json`: Illustrative passive report for renamed canonical MicroSandbox alias `msb-linux` under a `DEVSY_HOME` ancestor containing `/lib/` and `/bin/` where pinned archive `sha256:b3cc4a5e3f52dfdd938a6f67ac4a9a959ddfe304bab56de4964044b8613f01bb` is absent from cache (`reasonCode: "dependency_offline_asset_missing"`, `managedRecipe.enabled: false`, `install` action `enabled: false`).

### 3.2 Qualification Gates (`G01`-`G09`, SPEC.md Section 18.2) and Support Tuple Matrix

All gates `G01`-`G09` have execution state `NOT RUN`:
- `G01`: Published adapter selection (exact release implements `T08` path-pair and `runtime-check` contract with reproducible artifacts).
- `G02`: MicroSandbox bundle relocation (matching CLI/firmware and SDK resolution from private store paths without mutating real `$HOME/.microsandbox`).
- `G03`: macOS execution/signing (native Apple Silicon packaged launch and runtime load without re-signing or trust bypass).
- `G04`: Linux ABI/virtualization (supported libc, firmware load, current-user KVM, complete workspace lifecycle).
- `G05`: Runtime-home update contract (shared-home activation and recovery across two qualified versions; deferred from Release B).
- `G06`: Concurrency/removal integration (reference-safe mutation/launch locks, leases, and crash/race tests).
- `G07`: Effective environment/host boundary (discovery, CLI, SDK, and execution agreement across context/options/agent boundaries).
- `G08`: Desktop/CLI version skew (capability fallback and structured output compatibility across supported Desktop/CLI versions).
- `G09`: Vendor/license/distribution review (reviewed terms and notices for exact redistributed artifacts).

| Provider / Feature | Host Tuple | Baseline Policy / State | Managed Recipe Enabled | Blocking Gates (`NOT RUN`) | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `docker`, `podman`, `apple`, `lima`, `orbstack` | All supported OS/arch | `external_only` | `false` (no recipe) | N/A | Guided external detection only. |
| `microsandbox` | `linux/amd64` | Disabled prospective candidate (`not_run`) | `false` | `G01`, `G02`, `G04`, `G06`, `G07`, `G09` | First KVM target once `T08` adapter release and Linux qualification land. Does not depend on macOS `G03` or two-version update `G05`. |
| `microsandbox` | `darwin/arm64` | Disabled prospective candidate (`not_run`) | `false` | `G01`, `G02`, `G03`, `G06`, `G07`, `G09` | Requires named human qualification on Apple Silicon against a notarized release candidate (`G03`). |
| `microsandbox` | `linux/arm64` | Disabled prospective candidate (`blocked`) | `false` | `G01`, `G02`, `G04`, `G06`, `G07`, `G09` | Blocked by absent bare-metal/self-hosted arm64 KVM runner hardware and unrun qualification gates. |
| `microsandbox` | `windows/amd64` | `unsupported` | `false` (no recipe) | N/A | Unsupported host platform (`dependency_platform_unsupported`); Windows provides framework/fixture coverage only. |
| `microsandbox` two-version update activation | Any | Disabled (deferred from Release B) | `false` | `G05` | Requires a second qualified MicroSandbox version and shared-home update tests. |
| Desktop/CLI dependency controls | All Desktop platforms | Skew fallback required | N/A | `G08` | Desktop must fall back cleanly when paired with an older CLI. |
